content.value: The [[article/smoker|Smoker]] is the dedicated fuel-driven cooking station. It cooks the foods available at a [[article/campfire|Campfire]] and any additional assigned food recipes, with faster, more efficient processing.
Select a discovered food recipe and use quantity to load a batch. Cooking continues over time, rather than completing the entire requested quantity instantly.
Raw meats, cod, salmon and potatoes belong in the cooking system. They are not ordinary [[article/kiln|Kiln]] material recipes.
Category tabs, Craftable and material search work like the other recipe-list stations.
